prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. depth.jpg, segmentation.jpg and pose.jpg are the same 5 frames rendered as a monocular depth map (brighter = nearer to the camera wearer), an instance segmentation map (coloured masks with class labels), and a body/hand skeleton map (yellow = body, magenta = hands) on black. Look at all four images. For EACH of the three maps, describe the spatial understanding that map supports, using the RGB strip for context: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Say what each map shows that is hard to see in the RGB alone, and where the map looks unreliable. Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"depth": "...", "segmentation": "...", "pose": "..."} with 3-5 sentences each.

descriptions.depth: The depth map shows a flat tiled walkway receding from less than 1 m at the bottom edge to over 15 m into the dark background colonnade, with a planter, pole, and bush on the right in frame 1 at roughly 1.5–2.5 m (within close reach on the right before passing out of view in frame 2) and colonnade pillars on the left at 4–10 m. A woman in a dark dress and hat starts roughly 8–10 m ahead and slightly left in frame 1 alongside a companion within 0.5 m to her left, turns to face the camera wearer in frame 2 (~6–7 m), and approaches directly across frames 3 (~4 m) and 4 (~2 m) until she is within arm's reach (~0.5–0.8 m) in frame 5, completely occluding her companion behind her while her lower body is cropped below the frame. Two other pedestrians—one near the left storefront (~7–9 m away, moving left and partially out of view by frame 4) and one on the right carrying a bag (~6–10 m away, remaining 4–6 m to the right of the approaching woman)—stay well beyond arm's reach as they pass relative to the approaching camera wearer. The depth map clarifies the continuous ground-plane gradient, the structural recess of the unlit ceiling and pillars, and the rapid closing distance of the central woman better than the dark nighttime RGB image. However, it is unreliable where the woman's lower legs blend into the ground depth in frames 3–4, where the occluded companion behind her merges into her silhouette in frames 3–5, and where distant dark ceiling and background regions saturate to uniform black.
descriptions.segmentation: The instance segmentation map isolates up to four pedestrians and a handbag against the unsegmented plaza, tracking the primary woman (pink mask) as she turns toward the camera wearer and advances from roughly 8–10 m ahead on the left in frame 1 to within arm's reach (~0.5–0.8 m) at the bottom-center of frame 5, where her torso and raised hands are cut off by the bottom edge. In frames 1–2, a companion (brown/blue mask) stands less than 0.5 m to her left (~6–9 m from the camera) before moving directly behind her and becoming completely occluded in frames 3–5, while a leftmost pedestrian (cyan/green mask, ~7–9 m away and 3–4 m left of the woman) exits the left edge after frame 4 and a right-side pedestrian (brown mask, ~6–10 m away and 4–6 m right of the woman) shifts toward the right edge. In frames 3 and 4, a green 'handbag' mask appears directly on the front of the approaching woman's torso (~4 m and ~2 m away, within her own arm's reach), which moves within the camera wearer's arm's reach in frame 5 though no longer separately segmented. This map makes it easier than RGB alone to spot the dimly lit background pedestrians in frames 1–2 and to track when the companion becomes occluded behind the woman. However, it is unreliable where it misclassifies the strap and front of the woman's dress as a large green handbag covering her chest in frames 3–4, fragments the companion into overlapping 'person' labels in frame 2, and misses the companion's slightly visible shoulder behind the woman in frame 5 as well as all architectural obstacles like the pillars and foreground bush.
descriptions.pose: The pose map is completely blank across frames 1–3 when all pedestrians are roughly 4–10 m away, detecting a body skeleton only when the primary woman approaches to ~2 m in frame 4 and ~0.5–0.8 m (within arm's reach of the camera wearer) in frame 5. In frame 4, the yellow skeleton shows her standing upright in the left-center foreground facing and looking directly toward the camera wearer, with her right arm hanging down beside her hip, her left elbow bent near her torso within her own reach, and her legs mid-stride on the walkway. In frame 5, as she fills the lower center of the view with her torso cropped at the bottom, facial keypoints (eyes, ears, nose) confirm her head remains level and facing the camera wearer while her left arm bends sharply upward with a magenta hand skeleton raised to shoulder height on the right side of the frame, within 0.5–0.8 m of the camera wearer. The pose map explicitly resolves her forward-facing head orientation, walking stride in frame 4, and raised left hand configuration in frame 5 despite heavy motion blur in the RGB frame. However, it is highly unreliable for broader scene understanding because it fails to detect any people beyond ~2 m across all frames, misses the woman's right hand at the bottom-left edge of frame 5, and collapses her torso into a single horizontal line connecting her shoulders in frame 5 due to bottom-of-frame cropping.
